subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**as well as**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses various characteristics and themes of Romantic poetry.
 
• The correct word should add another feature of Romantic poetry alongside personal expression and introspection.
 
• "**As well as**" (**के साथ ही साथ**) fits well as it adds another element (a rejection of traditional poetic forms and structures) that complements the focus on personal expression and introspection.
 
• Other options ("**whereas**", "**therefore**", "**but**") do not fit the context of adding additional information without implying a cause-and-effect relationship or contrast.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Whereas (जबकि):** "Whereas" is used to introduce a contrast.
 
• **Therefore (अतः):** "Therefore" is used to introduce a logical conclusion or result.
 
• **But (लेकिन):** "But" is used to introduce a contrast or exception.
 
• **As well as (के साथ ही साथ):** "As well as" is used to add another element or information in addition to what has already been mentioned.
